newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CNPC surges on oil prices, expansion talk.
newsitem.headline: CNPC surges on oil prices, expansion talk.

text.p: Shares of China-funded oil explorer CNPC (Hong Kong) Ltd surged on Monday, as oil prices rose on news that the United Nations would put off plans to implement an oil-for-food deal with Iraq, brokers said.
They said there was also speculation the company was planning to buy oilfields in Southeast Asia, brokers added.
CNPC shares rose to an intraday high of HK$0.36 before closing the morning up HK$0.025 at HK$0.35.
"Iraq tensions are having a pyschological impact on the shares," said one dealing director at a regional brokerage.
